title: Dermalogica Age Bright Clearing Serum Label Explained: 2% Salicylic Acid
description:
Dermalogica Age Bright Clearing Serum, read line by line on the Bedfordview label desk: the claim, the numbers, the ingredient list and the directions.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link at https://dermatology.joburg/.

• Active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible skin aging (30 ml)
• Salicylic acid 2.0%; niacinamide is second on the ingredient list
• AGE Bright Complex; resurrection plant phytoactives; niacinamide with white shiitake mushroom
• Apply a thin layer, allow to dry, use under moisturizer up to twice a day as needed
• Sensitive skin: build up to daily use; sensitive to salicylic acid: patch test first or avoid
